$comment: THE NAME A NOTIFICATION GIVES A MEMBER OF A CONVERSATION, WRITTEN ONCE AND ASSERTED ON EVERY PLATFORM.
Owner, 2026-11-14: 'comme sur Messenger, tous les pseudos' - a notification names a member by the
nickname set in THAT conversation, whoever set it, lock screen included; and 'Tout pourrait etre
donne par l'appareil et rien par le serveur' - the DEVICE composes every name, no push carries one.
The device's copy is `conversation_nicknames.json` (written by Rust `store_conversation_nicknames`
from what the WebView holds, `nicknameMirror.ts`): `userId` is its owner; `scopes` maps a nickname
scope (an MLS group id, or `community:<workspace id>` for a community) to {member id: nickname};
`channels` maps a salon id (no `channel_` prefix) to its community's scope. Only nicknames the owner
may SEE are written (a nickname of the owner set by somebody in a block with them, or whose block
status is unknown, is not), so a reader applies no block rule of its own.
Readers: the client's `notificationNickname` (conversationNicknames.svelte.ts, against its own
Case fields: `me` the signed-in account; `kind` `group` (an MLS conversation, `conversation` is its
group id) or `salon` (`conversation` is a salon id, with or without its `channel_` prefix);
`member` the person named; `expected` the nickname, or null for 'no nickname - use the name the
platform already had' (the profile name from the phone's own copy).

cases.name: a group's nickname names its member
the member id is read in any case
a member nobody named keeps the profile name
a nickname never leaves its conversation
a salon reads its community's register
a salon id may carry its conversation prefix
a salon of a community with no register names nobody
a salon the device cannot place names nobody
a group id is never read as a salon
another account's copy is never read
